 BREAKING Burnley FC Burnley's predicted XI to face QPR in Fabio Celestini's first away game
 By Matt Scrafton Burnley FC writer
 Published 3rd Nov 2026, 06:00 GMT 
 How Burnley are predicted to line up against QPR
 Burnley head to the capital tonight to face QPR in Fabio Celestini’s first away game.
 The Clarets were held to a frustrating 0-0 draw against Portsmouth on Saturday as the new boss took to the dugout for the first time.
 While there were encouraging signs, Burnley were ultimately left disappointed not to claim a first home league win in over a year.
 Will Celestini keep faith with the same side as Saturday? Or, with the quick turnaround, will he look to make changes?
 Here’s how Burnley are predicted to line up:
 1 . GK - Gregoire Coudert
 Endured a couple of nervy moments against Portsmouth, but will keep his spot after Burnley kept a rare clean sheet. | Kelvin Lister-Stuttard
 Photo Sales 2 . RB - Kyle Walker
 The experienced right-back enjoyed one of his better displays in Burnley colours during the weekend's stalemate against Portsmouth. | Kelvin Stuttard Video & Photography
 Photo Sales 3 . CB - Hjalmar Ekdal
 While Anel Ahmedhodzic will be pushing to reclaim his place, Ekdal did enough to keep the shirt with his performance on Saturday. | Kelvin Stuttard Video & Photography
 Photo Sales 4 . CB - Igor Julio
 Wasn't the most convincing against Portsmouth at the weekend, but it would be a shock to see him drop out of the side as a result. | Kelvin Stuttard Video & Photography
